dataset_name: MedMatch Phase 2 Development Test Fixture & Evaluation Foundation
dataset_classification: DEVELOPMENT/TEST FIXTURE ONLY — NOT A RESEARCH EVALUATION BENCHMARK

development_fixture.description: Tiny deterministic synthetic fixture used strictly for schema validation, automated testing, and CI/CD regression verification. Not a research benchmark.

research_benchmark.description: External public gold-standard benchmark datasets (TrialGPT, TREC Clinical Trials) to be ingested and normalized in subsequent phases for primary quantitative research evaluation.

stress_test.description: Dedicated synthetic edge-case evaluation subset for testing numerical thresholds, temporal intervals, missing data, and contradictory evidence. Distinct from primary research benchmark.

sources.official_reference: U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM / NIH), https://clinicaltrials.gov/data-api/about-api
sources.acquisition_status: SOURCE IDENTIFIED — NOT YET INGESTED (Curated protocol NCT02484404 extracted as fixture template)
sources.data_contained: Protocol descriptions, brief titles, conditions, interventions, phase, eligibility criteria text blocks
sources.labels_contained: Zero patient records, zero eligibility labels, zero relevance qrels
sources.task_supported: Candidate trial protocol indexing and criteria text extraction

sources.official_reference: Qiao Jin et al., Nature Communications 15, Article 5772 (2024), DOI: 10.1038/s41467-024-49996-9
sources.data_contained: 184 synthetic EHR clinical narratives (derived from TREC/SIGIR cases)
sources.labels_contained: Criterion-level clinician annotations (tri-state: meets, fails, not mentioned) for ~1,200 patient-trial pairs (~2.5% of total pairs); aggregated trial-level eligibility labels
sources.task_supported: Criterion-level tri-state reasoning (PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN) and grounded decision attribution
sources.license_and_terms: Public Domain (NIH software) / MIT License on GitHub

sources.official_reference: Roberts et al., Overview of the TREC 2021 Clinical Trials Track, NIST Special Publication
sources.data_contained: 75 synthetic/semi-synthetic clinical case topics written by medical students and clinicians
sources.labels_contained: Retrieval relevance judgments (qrels): 0=irrelevant, 1=excluded, 2=eligible. NO criterion-level labels or character text spans.
sources.license_and_terms: Open Academic Research Use under NIST TREC guidelines

sources.official_reference: Roberts et al., Overview of the TREC 2022 Clinical Trials Track, NIST Special Publication
sources.labels_contained: Retrieval relevance judgments (qrels): 0, 1, 2. NO criterion-level labels.
sources.license_and_terms: Open Academic Research Use under NIST TREC guidelines

sources.official_reference: Johnson et al., Scientific Data (2023), PhysioNet
sources.task_supported: None (No trial screening labels, DUA prohibits open redistribution in Git)
sources.license_and_terms: PhysioNet Credentialed Data Use Agreement (Requires CITI training)

sources.data_contained: 1 curated protocol (NCT02484404) and 6 rule-derived synthetic patients
sources.task_supported: CI/CD automated testing, schema verification, and validator integrity testing

splits.fixture_splits_note: TEST FIXTURE ONLY — The 6-patient split below is a deterministic structural test partition for validator verification, NOT a statistically significant research evaluation split.

notes: The current dataset is strictly a development/test fixture and must NOT be represented as a sufficient benchmark for validating MedMatch performance.
External benchmarks (TrialGPT, TREC CT) are identified and audited, but NOT yet ingested into the codebase.
Zero Protected Health Information (PHI) is contained in this repository.
